prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service
Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer based on directory listings or reviews alone. A practical starting point is the **Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service**: it refers people with vehicle-injury cases to screened attorneys and can provide up to two referrals. The listed fee is **$40** for a referral and an initial consultation of up to 30 minutes. Call **(510) 302-2222, option 1**, or request a referral online at [acbanet.org/need-a-lawyer](https://www.acbanet.org/need-a-lawyer/).

When you speak with lawyers, ask:
- How much of your practice is car-accident injury work?
- Who will handle your case day to day?
- What is the contingency fee, and what case costs might you owe?
- How will they communicate updates and handle settlement offers?
- Have they handled cases with injuries and circumstances like yours?

Before hiring, verify the lawyer’s license and any public discipline history through the [State Bar of California attorney search](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/Public/Need-Legal-Help/Lawyer-Referral-Service). Don’t choose on star ratings alone; compare a couple of consultations and read the fee agreement carefully before signing.
